title: 3 Michelin Star Restaurants in the UK (2026 List)
description: Every 3 Michelin star restaurant in the UK, in London and beyond, with chef, cuisine and tasting menu price, plus this year’s star changes.
h1: 3 Michelin Star Restaurants in the UK
summary: Every three-star restaurant in the UK, from London to Bray and the Lake District.
body:
The UK has {{n3UK}} restaurants with three Michelin stars in the {{guideYear}} MICHELIN Guide Great Britain & Ireland, {{n3London}} of them in London. The rest are in the countryside, from Bray in Berkshire to the Lake District and Lancashire. Tasting menus start at {{cheapest3UKPrice}} per person. List last checked {{checked}}.

Here are all of the 3 Michelin star restaurants in the UK, with their chefs, cuisine and what the main tasting menu costs. Each name opens the restaurant’s prices on The Starred Bill, each town our prices for every starred restaurant nearby, and each arrow the restaurant’s page on the MICHELIN Guide. The UK has {{ukTotal}} starred restaurants in all: see our UK page.

How to book

  • Know the release date. Most of these restaurants open bookings a set number of weeks or months ahead, or on a fixed day each month. Their own websites say when.
  • Book direct. Use the restaurant’s website or the platform it links to, and join the waiting list if the date you want has gone; cancellations come up, especially a day or two before.
  • Expect a deposit. Many take a deposit or the full menu price when you book, with firm cancellation terms.
  • Try lunch. Where there is a lunch menu, it is usually the cheapest way in. Our destination pages list lunch prices wherever a restaurant offers one.
  • Check the service charge. UK menu prices usually include VAT, and most restaurants add a discretionary service charge of 12.5% to 15% on top.

For London on its own, see 3 Michelin star restaurants in London. For the world, see every three-Michelin-star restaurant.

faq.q: How many 3 Michelin star restaurants are there in the UK?
faq.a: {{n3UK}}, in the {{guideYear}} MICHELIN Guide Great Britain & Ireland: {{n3London}} in London and the rest elsewhere in England.

faq.q: What is the cheapest three-star restaurant in the UK?
faq.a: Of the UK three-star restaurants that publish a dinner tasting menu price, {{cheapest3UK}} in {{cheapest3UKPlace}} is the cheapest, at {{cheapest3UKPrice}} per person before service and drinks.

faq.q: Are there three-star restaurants in Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland?
faq.a: Not in the {{guideYear}} guide. Every UK three-star restaurant is in England, though Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland all have one- and two-star restaurants.
